title: Open interest
description: Whether perp positions are being opened or closed, read together with price. Rising interest on a rising price means new longs; falling interest on a rising price means shorts covering.

quadrant.label: Open interest read
quadrant.description: The four-way read of open interest against price: new longs, new shorts, longs closing or shorts covering. New positions push a move; closing ones end it.

delta_pct_1m.label: Change 1m
delta_pct_1m.description: How much open interest changed over the last minute, as a percentage. Positive means positions are being opened.

delta_pct_5m.label: Change 5m
delta_pct_5m.description: How much open interest changed over the last five minutes, as a percentage. Slower, but a run of one sign is a real build.

open_interest_notional_usd.label: Open interest
open_interest_notional_usd.description: The dollar value of all perp contracts outstanding on this venue. The base the percentage changes are measured against.

divergence.label: Divergence
divergence.description: Whether open interest and price are moving in opposite directions. Divergence often marks a move running out of new money.
